changes.title: Search results survive display recreation
changes.text: The UIMSD search-results list now restores exactly once after Android recreates the active statistics scene. It retains the exact query and result ordering, and a restored selection targets the rebuilt scene rather than the destroyed one; no run history, score, save, rules, combat or content behavior changes.

changes.title: Retain TEST342 evidence and verify the Search restorer
changes.text: Preserve rejected TEST342 as the immediate compiled comparison and keep owner-only TEST341 plus TEST330 as verified fallbacks. Core guards and the existing Android restoration scenario cover the exact Search results through two rebuilds and a restored selection on the active scene. Retain every diagnostic, report and history checkpoint; require complete core, debug, API34, API36, display, resource, signing and history gates before naming a new private candidate.

commentary: Preserve every compiled TEST342 history TSV and append exactly one new reviewed record. TEST342 is the immediate previous compiled APK but remains rejected and unpublished; TEST341 is the current owner-only published pair and TEST330 remains a verified fallback. This is one intentional application candidate for a reproduced offline UIMSD scene-recreation loss, not a verification-only rebuild. No public release, automatic tester distribution, physical-phone claim or billing change.
